title: The Prophet
dek: Three themes. Nine boons. Compare the effects and costs below.
sources: Fenumion 21–25 · The Prophet · A1:H60 · checked 17 October 2026 · https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Qk8H3SMq7-8_raesIkaPdNoq4XqgNsJpZRStwlg278o/edit#gid=1667378923

← Browse all blessings

Read down each theme to compare its three tiers. Each boon shows its listed cost. Open “Full original wording” for the complete passage, including its descriptive text.

Tier 11cost
Tier 22cost
Tier 33cost
Theme 1

The Clairvoyant

Tier 1Cost 1

You may cast silvery barbs as a reaction without expending a spell slot, once per day.

Full original wording

Not a master of fate, but a skilled gambler with the threads of possibility, you coax events toward your design. You may cast silvery barbs as a reaction without expending a spell slot, once per day.

Tier 2Cost 2

The world moves mostly as it must, but you find the subtle cracks where destiny’s flow can be eased or redirected. Roll a d12 at the start of the day. If even, you may add that value to any one d20 roll as a reaction. If odd, you may subtract that value from any one roll, also as a reaction

Full original wording

The world moves mostly as it must, but you find the subtle cracks where destiny’s flow can be eased or redirected. Roll a d12 at the start of the day. If even, you may add that value to any one d20 roll as a reaction. If odd, you may subtract that value from any one roll, also as a reaction

Tier 3Cost 3

A glowing aegis surrounds you, repelling the shadows of cursed destinies and malevolent design. As an action, you may create an aura round you where every creature within 10 feet cannot roll below a 10, this lasts for one minute and requires concentration.

Full original wording

A glowing aegis surrounds you, repelling the shadows of cursed destinies and malevolent design. As an action, you may create an aura round you where every creature within 10 feet cannot roll below a 10, this lasts for one minute and requires concentration.

Theme 2

The Way

Tier 1Cost 1

Your judgment is sure and your understanding profound, guided by a wisdom born of keen observation and deep reflection. For ten minutes, all of your wisdom based checks have advantage. You may not use this ability again until you complete a long rest

Full original wording

Your judgment is sure and your understanding profound, guided by a wisdom born of keen observation and deep reflection. For ten minutes, all of your wisdom based checks have advantage. You may not use this ability again until you complete a long rest

Tier 2Cost 2

Any persuasion or performance check to a crowd (larger than five people) cannot roll lower than a 17

Full original wording

Each word you utter shapes the will of those around you, bending doubts into resolve and hesitation into action. Any persuasion or performance check to a crowd (larger than five people) cannot roll lower than a 17

Tier 3Cost 3

Bound by sacred vow or higher calling, your speech cannot be twisted into a weapon. From your lips, only peace may pass. As an action, you may utter a command and for one minute any humanoids under CR 4 must drop their weapons and use their action to flee or surrender. This requires concentration.

Full original wording

Bound by sacred vow or higher calling, your speech cannot be twisted into a weapon. From your lips, only peace may pass. As an action, you may utter a command and for one minute any humanoids under CR 4 must drop their weapons and use their action to flee or surrender. This requires concentration.

Theme 3

The Holy

Tier 1Cost 1

You may cast bless as a fifth level spell, using a spell slot. If you do so, it does not require concentration.

Full original wording

You carry a light that spills into those around you, shielding them from harm and guiding their blades true. You may cast bless as a fifth level spell, using a spell slot. If you do so, it does not require concentration.

Tier 2Cost 2

When you drop to 0 hitpoints for the first time in the day, you may, as a reaction, spread 1d4*Level hitpoints in healing amongst your allies, not including you. This causes one failed death save

Full original wording

You give of yourself so others may rise. Whether blood, breath, or strength, you offer it freely. When you drop to 0 hitpoints for the first time in the day, you may, as a reaction, spread 1d4*Level hitpoints in healing amongst your allies, not including you. This causes one failed death save

Tier 3Cost 3

You may use Divine Intervention once every three days on a successful use of it, instead of the normal seven days.

Full original wording

Your prayers are not whispers—they are commands wrapped in reverence, and the divine answers without delay. You may use Divine Intervention once every three days on a successful use of it, instead of the normal seven days.
